card: L5 baseline freeze + read-only Cell Ontology explanation layer
what_it_is: A read-only explanation layer over one fixed Cell Ontology snapshot: it reports what the graph says about a term or a pair of terms, and separately whether that answer holds under the sample, task granularity and evidence at hand. It corrects an evaluation wording, it does not raise identification ability.

tools.name: resolve_term
tools.returns: canonical_id, preferred_label, obsolete_status, resolution_status, candidates, unresolved_reason

tools.name: get_ancestors
tools.returns: ancestors with levels_above, path, line, blanket flag

tools.name: compare_terms
tools.returns: five-bucket verdict + is_a_relation + ancestor_path + unresolved_reason + assessment

tools.name: explain_class_mapping
tools.returns: the shipped mapping record, the graph facts behind it, and an assessment

route_semantics: The tools are registered only when the route variable names them explicitly (a comma-separated list of tool names). Unset, empty, or naming no known tool = no ontology tool is advertised and no ontology code is imported by the server; the advertised tool list and every existing answer are then byte-identical to the pre-change release. There is no whitelist entry by default: the list is empty, so the capability cannot be reached by default in any state.
opt_out: Unsetting EYEKB_ONT_LAYER restores the pre-change surface byte-for-byte; that is the state every measurement in this card's report was taken in.

anchor_failure_policy.ANCHOR_MISSING: FAIL - a mandatory delivered asset is absent from the delivery
anchor_failure_policy.ANCHOR_HASH_MISMATCH: FAIL - the bytes are not the recorded bytes
anchor_failure_policy.ANCHOR_UNKNOWN: FAIL - an address the manifest does not list
anchor_failure_policy.MANIFEST_MISSING: FAIL - the manifest itself is absent
anchor_failure_policy.ENV_ERROR: reserved for a declared external precondition that is genuinely outside the delivery; a missing shipped asset is never reported this way

bucket_rules.same_term: canonically identical CL term; a naming difference only
bucket_rules.ours_broader: our term is an ancestor of the reference term
bucket_rules.ours_narrower: the reference term is an ancestor of ours; the extra resolution is unverified and earns nothing
bucket_rules.confirmed_incompatible: reached only when the caller supplies explicit incompatibility evidence, which is recorded verbatim with the verdict
bucket_rules.not_supported_by_is_a: no ancestor relation in either direction, or one side unmapped. NOT counted as correct, NOT reported as a confirmed error: multiple inheritance, incomplete ontologies and cross-classification all produce this state

two_layer_record.is_a_relation: what the graph says (same_canonical_term / ours_is_ancestor_of_theirs / theirs_is_ancestor_of_ours / no_ancestor_relation / unresolved)
two_layer_record.assessment: whether the answer holds under this sample, task granularity and evidence (not_assessed / supported / resolution_limited / evidence_insufficient / unmapped / under_review / incompatible)
two_layer_record.rule: The two fields are returned side by side and neither is derived from the other. A parent-child relation is not by itself a correct answer.

reporting_tables.rule: Three separate tables, each with a fixed denominator over the recorded population, and never a single lenient accuracy that mixes them: a correct-but-coarse answer is a resolution limitation, not a biological error.
tables: granularity relation (coarser / finer / levels crossed, plus below-minimum-reporting-granularity)
task validity (context qualified / meets reporting granularity / evidence sufficient / still under review)

granularity_rules.rule: A relation that only reaches an ancestor with this many or more active CL descendants does not meet the minimum reporting granularity and may not be counted as a usable coarse answer. The threshold is declared here, before any comparison was run, and is not moved afterwards.
granularity_rules.shared_ancestor: A shared ancestor is not equivalence and is never reported as one.

stop_line: no favourable synonym is ever preferred to raise agreement
an extremely broad ancestor may not blanket an answer
no unmapped count is reduced, and no agreement is raised, by any of the above
parser_handles: obsolete terms with a unique replacement (ambiguity goes to review)
synonym ambiguity (only a unique resolution is auto-accepted)
missing imports (declared imports and parents that point outside the file)
OWL restriction and equivalence expressions, recorded separately and never read as named-class is_a edges
not_in_effective_profile: With EYEKB_ONT_LAYER unset, the capability contributes nothing to the effective profile: the tools are not advertised, the snapshot is not parsed, no anchor is resolved, and the identity record lists the layer under registered_capabilities with state OFF. docs/RELEASE_IDENTITY.json carries the effective-profile identity this claim belongs to.
